name: Zharkoye
desc: A meat dish served in a clay pot. Cubed ingredients are placed into the pot, sealed with dough, and then baked in the oven. Once it is done, the crisp bread cap is lifted off, and sour cream is added for seasoning. The method itself is not complicated, but controlling the oven temperature and braising time takes quite the experience.

value.text: Restores 32% of Max HP and an additional 1,250 HP to the selected character.
